name: AscalonDecisionOntology
description: Typed decision schema specifications for Project Ascalon

NOUL.description: Binary truth-value proposition with explicit probability of true and epistemic confidence

CHOICE.description: Categorical selection among a predefined, non-empty set of declared options with full probability distribution
constraints: probabilities contains every declared option exactly once
for all p in probabilities: 0.0 <= p <= 1.0

SCORE.description: Bounded numerical evaluation against a declared rubric level
